caption.en: A grid of four icons representing the four main biomolecules: a carbohydrate (glucose ring), a lipid (glycerol and fatty acid), a protein (amino acid chain), and a nucleic acid (DNA strand).
caption.tl: Apat na icon na kumakatawan sa apat na pangunahing biomolecule: carbohydrate (glucose ring), lipid (glycerol at fatty acid), protein (chain ng amino acid), at nucleic acid (DNA strand).
caption.bis: Upat ka icon nga nagrepresenta sa upat ka nag-unang biomolecule: carbohydrate (glucose ring), lipid (glycerol ug fatty acid), protein (kadena sa amino acid), ug nucleic acid (DNA strand).
